causes: Installed Silero speech starts after 100 ms at default 0.5; LiveKit interruption used 150 ms. Silero silence hold can advance speech duration after a brief noise.
Firmware encoded both active wakeword and explicit button/stop-word as LOCAL_STOP; server restarted capture by design.
Physical audio sink does not support pause/resume, so false-interruption resume could not restore interrupted speech.

changes.protocol: END_SESSION=150 ends media; LOCAL_STOP preserves active wakeword relistening; MUTED stays terminal. Terminal events can overtake pending interruption without recapture.
changes.backgroundWork: No task cancellation added; existing task state and return session lifecycle preserved.
changes.preserved: Existing LiveKit 1.8, Silero, HA STT/TTS providers, core models, credentials, audio path, AEC configuration and wrapper. Five media modules and one firmware protocol header changed.

verification.vadPolicy: Controlled speech-probability fixtures: original accepts 128 ms peak and long 0.60 noise; candidate rejects both; sustained 0.95 speech starts after approximately 224 ms. No measured room-audio accuracy or end-to-end latency claim.
verification.fixtures: Distroless image lacks openssl CLI and legacy FFmpeg CLI. Existing local tools/runtime used; attempted cryptography fixture reverted. No production dependency installation.
